description: Read Tuesday and Wednesday in the almanac

participation.context: Read the two lines and left them.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You saw the two days marked dark and you did not write a play into either of them.

title: Read the almanac for the last two days

description: Read the bill for Wise Man

participation.context: Read the two lines and walked back toward the close.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You read Wise Man and the Admiral's company on a Bishopsgate post, stepped back, and turned toward the close. You did not go to the Rose.

title: Read the Rose's bill for Wise Man

description: Stepped back from the posted bill

participation.context: Stood in the street and turned back.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You looked at the post and you did not take the road to the Rose.

title: Stepped back from the post

description: Came home from the bill and turned to the leaf

participation.context: Said the title once and hung the cloak up.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You read Wise Man once, on the post, and you came home. You did not go on to the Rose.

title: Came back from the bill
